title: Sabha transcript@v1
description: The canonical transcript of one recording, saved by the transcribe stage (P3.7) as transcript@v1.json. Every time is on the ORIGINAL recording timeline (golden rule 4). Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by sabha_asr.assembly.validate_transcript: every utterance has start_ms < end_ms; utterances are sorted by start_ms; each low-confidence span has start < end <= len(text) and spans are sorted and do not overlap.

timeline.description: Which timeline the times are on. Always the original recording, never compact audio.

asr_model.description: Model id and version of the ASR that produced the words, as recorded in asr@v1.json.

word_timing.description: How word times were obtained: "word" when the ASR timed each word, "approximate" when it timed only phrases and words were spread across them (ADR 0006). Absent means "word".

word_count.description: Number of ASR words in the transcript.

utterance.description: Consecutive words of one speaker, not spanning a removed silence of split_silence_ms or more.

role.description: Role from roles@v1.json, named by the rubric (for example teacher, students, receptionist, caller). Students are a group role.

speaker_label.description: The diarizer's anonymous cluster id. Not a person's identity.

start_ms.description: Start of the first word, original timeline, integer milliseconds.

end_ms.description: End of the last word, original timeline, integer milliseconds; after start_ms.

text.description: The words joined by single spaces.

avg_confidence.description: Mean confidence of the words that have one, rounded to 4 decimals; null when the ASR gives no word confidence (ADR 0006).

low_confidence_spans.description: Half-open [start, end) character ranges of text covering runs of consecutive words whose confidence is below the threshold. Indices count Unicode code points.
